نتهامس (form VI)
# نَتَهَامَسُ (natahāmasu) /na.ta.haː.ma.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَهَامَسَ (tahāmasa)
# نَتَهَامَسَ (natahāmasa) /na.ta.haː.ma.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَهَامَسَ (tahāmasa)
# نَتَهَامَسْ (natahāmas) /na.ta.haː.mas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَهَامَسَ (tahāmasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
